selection_principle: Benchmarks selected by same vertical and decision-job comparability before any Decision Loss calculation. No benchmark selected to maximize gap.

decision_jobs.D1: reduce fear/anxiety and perceived procedural risk
decision_jobs.D2: reduce economic friction through pricing/payment accessibility
decision_jobs.D3: increase confidence in advanced implantology/complex-case capability
decision_jobs.D4: reduce time-to-fixed-teeth through immediate-load/rapid rehabilitation proposition
decision_jobs.D5: increase trust and decision support through proof, team, service and CTA
